summary: innoscripta SE provides software-as-a-service for managing research and development tax incentives and project management consulting in European markets. It offers Clusterix, a scalable software platform for the structured organization and management of research and development activities. Its Clusterix is by companies to manage innovation projects, digitize internal processes, and make their R&D activities transparent and scalable. The company offers solutions for research and development documentation, such as human resources, task management, organization, project management, and time tracking.
